text: New Era (New Era Cap Co., LLC, Buffalo, New York; led by CEO Christopher H. Koch) is a family-owned company: founded in 1920 by Ehrhardt Koch and described in Christopher Koch's published biography as 'the family-owned company New Era', of which he is the fourth generation CEO.
short: New Era is family-owned, led by fourth-generation Koch family CEO Christopher H. Koch.

source.name: Jackie Robinson Foundation: Christopher Koch (board member biography)
source.quote: Christopher H. Koch is the fourth generation CEO of the family-owned company New Era.

additionalSources.name: New Era Cap Foundation (the company's foundation)
additionalSources.quote: New Era Cap, LLC which was founded by Ehrhardt Koch in 1920 and is currently led by 4th Generation CEO, Chris Koch.
